card.name: Words pointing to other or previous items
card.fires_on: Words that refer to other or earlier members of a group, such as 'other members', 'other barbiturates', 'previous' and 'concomitant', mostly in drug-label text.

modes.label: Other members of a class
modes.description: A word after 'other' that points to additional drugs in the same class.

modes.label: Previous or concomitant
modes.description: The word 'previous' or 'concomitant' that refers to earlier or accompanying therapy or events.
modes.example: Six or more<< previous>> term pregnancies ( 4 )
